instruction: Draft a reply to Marco saying we can't do 20% off, but don't send it. I want to read it first.
final_text:
I saved a draft reply to Marco Bianchi in the "Re: Renewal pricing" thread. It hasn't been sent. He'd asked for 20% off if Verdant commits to two years. The draft says:

> Hi Marco,
>
> Thanks for getting back to me, and we appreciate that you're thinking about a two-year commitment.
>
> Unfortunately we can't do 20% off. I'm glad to talk through other options for the renewal, though. Let me know if you'd like to set up a quick call.
>
> Best,
> Sam

The draft doesn't offer a smaller discount. If you're willing to go lower for two years, tell me the number and I'll add it. You can also make changes yourself in Gmail, or ask me to send it once you're happy with it.

Sam
